Interface StaticBodyGenerator.SelfAccess

Enclosing class:
StaticBodyGenerator
public static interface StaticBodyGenerator.SelfAccess
How a compiled body reaches the properties of self: a Java field of the stub, or the member of the Python object behind it.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

    • read

      io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef read(String property, String typeName, io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef type, boolean accessor)
      Parameters:
      property - The property
      typeName - The Java type of the property, as the IR spells it

    • readFixed

      default io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef readFixed(String property, String typeName, io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef type)
      An attribute fixed at construction (see Ir.SelfProperty.fixed()): a stub reads it from the Python object once per object and keeps the converted value in a Java field; a body run on a Python object without a stub reads it as any other attribute.
      Parameters:
      property - The attribute
      typeName - The Java type of the attribute, as the IR spells it
      type - The Java type of the attribute
      Returns:
      The expression reading it

    • invoke

      io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef invoke(String name, List<io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef> parameterTypes, List<io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef> arguments, String typeName, io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef type, boolean direct)
      Parameters:
      name - The method of the class to call on self
      parameterTypes - The Java parameter types of the stub method, when dispatched to the stub
      arguments - The arguments, at the parameter types when dispatched to the stub, else boxed
      typeName - The Java return type as the IR spells it, void for none
      type - The Java return type
      direct - Whether the stub's Java method is called; else the method of the Python object
      Returns:
      The expression calling it

    • invokeShared

      default io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef invokeShared(String name, List<io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef> parameterTypes, List<io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ExpressionDef> arguments, String typeName, io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeDef type)
      A call of the shared entry of a compiled method of the class, which works on the caller's collections; without one, the method of the Python object, which does too.
      Parameters:
      name - The method of the class to call on self
      parameterTypes - The Java parameter types of the stub method
      arguments - The arguments, at the parameter types
      typeName - The Java return type as the IR spells it, void for none
      type - The Java return type
      Returns:
      The expression calling it
